{{Top|leg}}
A '''starpilot training device''' was a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]-based orbital device used to train [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. It would release a salvo of non-lethal [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] when fired upon.

==History==
At least one was present in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] orbit around the time of [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|its fall]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. During an escape from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], it was employed by Horn to distract and hinder a pursuing flight of [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]].
